title: Manual QIAgen DNA Extraction
author: Clemens Scherzer
materials: Gather all the necessary reagents/buffers (Buffer AE, Buffer AW1, Buffer AW2, Buffer AL, 100% ethanol, Qiagen Protease).
Pipet 20 µL, Qiagen protease into the bottom of a 1.5ml microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Equipment
steps.instruction: Prepare the heating block and reagents for the extraction process.

substeps.instruction: Thaw buffy coats or whole bloods by equilibrating to Room temperature.
Heat a heating block to 56 °C.
If a precipitate has formed in Buffer AL, dissolve by incubating at 56 °C.
Gather the required number of QIAamp Mini spin columns and 2ml collection tubes.

steps.title: Lysis of Sample
steps.instruction: Lyse the blood sample using Buffer AL.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL of BC/WB to a 1.5ml microcentrifuge tube.
Add 200 µL of Buffer AL to the sample.
Mix by pulse-vortexing for 15 seconds at half-speed to ensure a homogeneous solution.
Incubate on the 56 °C heat block for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Sample Preparation for Binding
steps.instruction: Prepare the lysed sample for column binding.

substeps.instruction: Briefly centrifuge the 1.5ml microcentrifuge tubes to remove drops from the inside of the lid.
Add 200 µL of 100% ethanol to the sample.
Mix by pulse-vortexing for 15 seconds.
Briefly centrifuge the 1.5ml microcentrifuge tube to remove drops from the inside of the lid.

steps.title: DNA Binding
steps.instruction: Bind the DNA to the QIAamp Mini spin column.

substeps.instruction: Carefully add the sample to the QIAamp Mini spin column (placed in a 2ml collection tube) without wetting the rim.
Close the cap and centrifuge at 20,000 x g (14,000 rpm) for 1 minute.

steps.title: First Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the column with Buffer AW1.

substeps.instruction: Carefully add 500 µL of Buffer AW1 to the spin column without wetting the rim.
Close the cap and centrifuge at 6,000 x g for 1 minute.
Place the spin column in a clean 2ml collection tube and discard the previous collection tube containing the filtrate.

steps.title: Second Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the column with Buffer AW2.

substeps.instruction: Carefully add 500 µL of Buffer AW2 to the spin column without wetting the rim.
Close the cap and centrifuge at 20,000 x g (14,000 rpm) for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Column Drying
steps.instruction: Perform a dry spin to remove residual ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Place the spin column in a new 2ml collection tube and discard the old collection tube.
Centrifuge at 20,000 x g (14,000 rpm) for 1 minute.

steps.title: DNA Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the purified DNA from the column.

substeps.instruction: Place the spin column in a clean 1.5ml microcentrifuge tube labeled with HBS IDs and discard the collection tube.
Carefully add 150 µL of Buffer AE to the spin column.
Incubate at Room temperature for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge at 6,000 x g (8,000 rpm) for 1 minute.
Repeat the elution process with a second 150 µL aliquot of Buffer AE.
Combine the two 150 µL aliquots, mix, and split them.
